body.condition: For every \(i\in[n]\), there is \(z_i\in Z_{\theta i}\) such that, for every lift increment \(|u|\le\min\{\Delta_0/4,1\}\), \(a_0|u|^m\le |r_{\theta i}'(z_i+u)|\le K|u|^m\).

novel.justification: The condition makes the class index \(m\) an attained worst critical order rather than a loose upper label. The displayed trigonometric family attains order \(m\) at \(0\) and \(\pi\), while its remaining critical points have no larger order.
